text: Rice is cooked slowly in milk, which thickens as it reduces and as the starch swells; sugar and spice go in towards the end. The Wikipedia page gives no temperatures or times, so none are listed.

steps.note: Rice, or cracked wheat, vermicelli, sago or tapioca, cooked in the milk until it thickens.

steps.what: sugar or jaggery, cardamom, saffron, almonds and raisins
